executive_summary.headline: Presence strengthened through the week, with the cleanest strategic movement arriving late in the decision cycle.

pattern_insights: Early-week conversations required more correction after pressure questions, but midweek execution settled into a steadier rhythm.
Buyer trust improved when positioning stayed outcome-led instead of detail-heavy, especially in the second half of the week.
The final calls show the strongest combination of composure and authority, suggesting the week closed with cleaner control.

directional_takeaway.text: The strategic direction is positive. Protect the same measured pacing next week and use it to sharpen transitions into objection handling and the close.
